# Tymor 1.0.6
## ✨ What's new
- Refreshed light color palettes with richer Jewel Tones, a separate Deep & Muted collection, and teal-led Aurora. Uniform Warm White, Pearl White, Amber and Ember options join more intentional seasonal color combinations and clearer palette names. - Added Christmas, Halloween, Winter and Romance shortcuts beside “Your mix,” just before the shape count. Each selects a ready-made bulb combination you can customize further, keeping your colors and other lighting settings unchanged. Your chosen bulbs are saved independently of the shortcuts, so future preset updates won't alter your mix. - Choose a color for each bulb shape directly from its color dot in “Your mix”—for example, green trees and white stars. Choices are remembered separately for each palette and apply to every bulb of that shape. The picker shows each distinct color once, and color controls stay hidden for single-color palettes. - Added menu bar toggles for screen and window lights, shortcuts to light settings and wallpapers, and a Performance submenu for frame rate and power-saving options.
## 🐞 Bug fixes
- The menu bar now explains when power saving pauses lights, including when weather effects are turned off.

# Tymor 1.0.5
## ✨ What's new
- **Celebration lights:** Hang lights along your screen edges and across window tops from a new **Lights** settings page. Screen and window lights have separate switches and customization, and work with any ambience—even when weather is turned off. - **Make each strand your own:** Choose glass bulbs, stars, hearts, pumpkins, ghosts, bats, snowflakes, trees or sparks, or mix shapes along a strand. Pick from eight color collections or create your own, then adjust bulb size, spacing, brightness and glow. - **Light motion and wire controls:** Choose Still, Swell, Shimmer, Candle, Merry Chase or Comet, with adjustable speed and depth. Shape strands by dragging hooks and adjusting droop, with live previews over your wallpaper. Lights respect Reduce Motion and your power-saving settings. - **Simpler Winter settings:** Snow accumulation, snowplow and sound controls now live in a **Snow** tab, with snowman instructions, scarves and caps in a separate **Snowman** tab.

# Tymor 1.0.4
## 🐞 Bug fixes
- Improved recovery from license verification failures, with a retry option when a saved license is blocked. - Fixed offline license access failing to expire while Tymor stays open. - Prevented overlapping activation, verification, and deactivation requests from leaving the license in an incorrect state.
